    Profile

    Veloz is a young man working in a clock tower in Slothstein. He was once an excellent student, but he lost his drive after the death of his parents. One thing he does love is tinkering around with devices. Even today, he's still developing all kinds of robots that help him make his life easier.

    Origin: Slothstein
    Gender: Male
    Height: 170cm
    Weight: 58kg
    Birthday: Oct 1
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Fiery Imperial Skies
    Likes: Hammocks
    Hobbies: Planning his next device
    Illust: ―
